baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَرَىٰهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ ... يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرْفٍ خَفِىٍّ
baseline_models.mechanism: Open display and concealed looking form an asymmetric field of vision: the addressee sees the people as exposed objects while their own gaze is lowered, marginal, and partly hidden.

activation_trace.role: Eye or insight perception gives the external observer an unimpeded view of the people.
Bringing something out for inspection makes the people the displayed objects of the scene.
Lowered head, gaze, voice, and limbs give the display its contracted bodily posture.
Breaking under coercive humiliation explains why the posture is compelled rather than chosen gentleness.
Directed ocular attention preserves an active attempt to see inside an otherwise passive display.
The eye, blink, or curtailed glance reduces that attempt to the smallest visual motion.
Concealment qualifies the glance, not the displayed bodies, sharpening the unequal visibility.

changed_reading.before: A scene in which humiliated people happen to look timidly at punishment.
changed_reading.after: A regime of unequal visibility in which they are fully inspectable but can exercise sight only through a contracted, concealed edge-glance.

baseline_models.mechanism: The noun-verb repetition turns loss into both identity and action, while its direct objects make the lost capital the person's own self and network of intimate belonging.

activation_trace.role: General diminution makes loss a reduction of the losers themselves, reinforced by the repeated root.
Commercial loss supplies a balance-sheet image in which the exposed stake is not external property.
The thing's very self or essence identifies the first lost asset with the agent's own whole identity.
The group formed by household, kinship, residence, or affiliation expands loss into relational belonging.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers lose a favorable outcome and are separated from family.
changed_reading.after: Loss has consumed both poles that could still count as theirs: the self that possesses and the intimate community through which that self belongs.

baseline_models.mechanism: Two forms of q-w-m bind the event of creatures rising to a punishment that stands, stays, or becomes their settled condition; the day does not merely begin pain but installs it.

activation_trace.role: Resurrection and the rising of creatures supply the initiating event in the repeated root.
Residence in a place or time gives muqim the settled persistence produced by that event.
Severe painful punishment names what the repeated q-w-m forms establish and sustain.

changed_reading.before: Punishment occurs on resurrection day and lasts.
changed_reading.after: The rising itself inaugurates a standing, settled condition: resurrection and duration are coupled through one root.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated address 'you see' first shows wrongdoers fearing what they earned as it falls and fixes upon them, then shows them seeing the punishment, and finally shows them as the objects displayed to it. The seers become the exhibit.

activation_trace.role: The first open act of seeing begins the staged visual recurrence with wrongdoers as its object.
Seeking and obtaining gain supplies the action whose result the wrongdoers now fear.
Falling and becoming fixed turns the earned result from an abstraction into something arriving upon them.
Seeing occurs both in the observer formula and in the wrongdoers' direct encounter, advancing the visual sequence.
Exposure for inspection completes the shift from seeing an outcome to seeing the agents displayed to it.
Their residual directed gaze keeps them conscious participants even after they become displayed objects.
The curtailed eye-glance marks the final collapse of the direct seeing present one ayah earlier.

structural_cues: 42:22, 42:44, and 42:45 repeat the second-person seeing formula while moving from feared earnings, to seeing punishment, to the people themselves being displayed.
The shift from رَأَوُا۟ in 42:44 to يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرْفٍ خَفِىٍّ in 42:45 contracts their visual agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated seeing constructions, earned consequence, falling-upon, direct encounter, and passive display; I supply the directional arrow that reads them as successive stages. A live alternative is emphatic recurrence without a narrated chronology.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an isolated tableau of fearful looking.
changed_reading.after: It is the terminal visual stage of earned consequence: what they once saw approaching now fixes upon them, and those who looked become exposed objects able only to steal a glance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent active أَعْرَضُوا۟ and passive يُعْرَضُونَ reverse agency within one root: turning one's side away from the message is answered by being brought out and made to face what was evaded.

activation_trace.role: Turning away while presenting one's side supplies the active posture of evasion.
Being brought out for inspection reverses that posture into involuntary exposure.

structural_cues: The post-focus conditional فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ stands within three ayat of the focus passive يُعْرَضُونَ and uses the same root with opposed voice and agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the active turning-away branch and passive display branch; I infer an ironic causal reversal from their adjacency. The alternative is a non-causal lexical echo joining warning and judgment.

changed_reading.before: They are simply presented to punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their exposure is a reversal of evasion: those who exercised agency by turning aside lose control of their side and are themselves turned into the presented object.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah q-w-m names voluntary establishment of religion and prayer and straight adherence to the commanded path. In the focus, the same root names resurrection and abiding punishment, converting refused self-establishment into imposed standing and emplacement.

activation_trace.role: Rising with resolve to an affair gives أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلدِّينَ the surah's first voluntary q-w-m demand.
Straightness and rectitude make the commanded stance directional and ethical.
Undertaking and establishing prayer repeats q-w-m as chosen practice.
The straight path closes the surah with the offered direction of q-w-m.
Resurrection makes standing universal and no longer voluntary.
Settled residence turns the imposed standing into an enduring condition.

structural_cues: أَقِيمُوا۟, ٱسْتَقِمْ, أَقَامُوا۟, ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ, مُّقِيمٍ, and مُّسْتَقِيمٍ distribute one root across command, practice, judgment, duration, and path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the q-w-m recurrence and its branches of resolve, rectitude, resurrection, and residence; I infer a reversal from voluntary alignment to compulsory standing. A live alternative is broad root cohesion without punitive conversion.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection and abiding are conventional time markers around punishment.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the involuntary endpoint of the surah's standing vocabulary: one may establish and stand straight now, or be raised into a condition that remains established over oneself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cultivation, earning, and increase build an acquisition economy; earned results then fall upon agents and can wreck and trap their vessels. The focus's repeated kh-s-r becomes the final account in which self and household, not merely profit, are the capital lost.

activation_trace.role: Gathering, earning, and labor make both harvest choices sustained projects of acquisition.
Seeking and obtaining gain names the wrongdoers' own productive action.
The acquired result falls and settles back upon its acquirers.
A second attribution to earnings carries the acquisition logic into the ship image.
Falling into destruction turns accumulated gain into the cause of catastrophic loss.
Trading loss supplies the final accounting category that answers the surah's repeated acquisition.
The self or very essence is revealed as part of the capital exposed to loss.
Household and intimate affiliation complete the account beyond the isolated individual.

structural_cues: 42:20 contrasts two harvest projects; 42:22 and 42:30 attach outcomes to what agents earned; 42:34 can wreck the ships by what their occupants earned.
The focus repeats kh-s-r first as an identity and then as a verb before naming its two direct objects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cultivation, acquisition, increase, falling consequence, earned wreck, and trading-loss branches; I supply the accounting arrow that treats these as one settlement process. The alternative is a looser sequence of moral cause and effect without economic integration.

changed_reading.before: The losers fail to gain salvation.
changed_reading.after: The surah's acquisition cycle closes with a negative settlement: what agents cultivated and earned returns upon them until the apparent owner and the owner's household are disclosed as the lost principal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pairing, progeny, kin-affection, gift, alliance, and refuge make household a created network of mutual shelter. Immediately after the focus, protecting allies and refuge disappear; losing ahl therefore includes collapse of the relations by which a self is paired, continued, loved, and sheltered.

activation_trace.role: A counterpart joined to its counterpart supplies the basic relational architecture of household.
Progeny and descendants extend pairing into generational continuity.
Affection supplies the inward social bond rather than mere biological adjacency.
Kinship by womb and descent makes that affection specifically relational and familial.
Love, support, and alliance name the protective relation explicitly absent after the focus.
Taking shelter in a refuge supplies the protective function that is denied.
The distant spouse branch lets the denied refuge resonate, cautiously, with the lost domestic bond.
Gift without exchange frames children and family formation as bestowed rather than possessed capital.
Making one thing a partner to another closes the surah with constituted pairing.
The self as one's very identity is the node whose relational constitution collapses.
Household, kin, residence, and affiliation gather the distributed context relations into the focus anchor.

structural_cues: 42:11 and 42:49-50 bracket the surah with pairing and procreation, while 42:46-47 immediately follow the focus with no protecting allies and no refuge.
The coordinated objects أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ prevent household loss from being detached from loss of self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pairing, descent, kin-affection, gift, support, refuge, self, and household; I infer that these distributed relations form one sheltering network. The spouse branch of l-j-ʾ is especially distant, and the live alternative is simply literal loss of family members.

changed_reading.before: Each person loses self and separately loses family members.
changed_reading.after: The loss is relational unmaking: the self loses the paired, generative, affectionate, protective shelter through which it had household identity, and the next ayat confirm that no substitute alliance or refuge remains.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate legal-social sequence limits response to equivalence, leaves pardon and reconciliation open, exempts the vindicated victim, and places the path of liability only upon those who wrong people and exceed right. The focus label 'wrongdoers' therefore arrives after calibrated alternatives have been distinguished.

activation_trace.role: Answering an act with its consequence supplies the sequence's redress frame.
Equivalence limits redress to a matching response rather than uncontrolled retaliation.
Foregoing punishment and effacing fault keeps a non-punitive exit live.
Removing estrangement between people makes pardon reparative rather than passive.
Crossing the limit through aggression identifies the conduct that activates liability.
A right belonging to its holder supplies the boundary violated by aggression.
The traversable path becomes the construction's channel of warranted claim against the aggressor.
Withholding or blocking right specifies wrongdoing as an injury to people, not a free-floating label.
The focus designation carries the just-developed rights violation into the enduring consequence.
Painful punishment is placed after, and functionally constrained by, the calibrated redress corridor.

structural_cues: 42:40-43 distinguish equivalent response, pardon with reconciliation, justified self-vindication, aggression against people, patience, and forgiveness immediately before 42:44-45.
إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى in 42:42 restricts the route of liability before 42:45 declares the wrongdoers in enduring punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equivalence, pardon, reconciliation, vindication, aggression, right, restricted liability, and the repeated z-l-m label; I infer that this corridor controls how the focus punishment is read. The alternative is that the ethical sequence and judgment scene are adjacent but not juridically integrated.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoers receive an undifferentiated punitive fate.
changed_reading.after: Their enduring punishment closes a carefully delimited social process: measured redress and reconciliation were available, victims were exempted, and liability attaches to those who crossed limits and withheld people's right.

context_deltas.mechanism: Return, path, protecting alliance, and refuge are successively denied around the focus. The prepositions of being displayed upon it and being in abiding punishment thus become a terminal spatial grammar: emplacement with no route back, out, or under protection.

activation_trace.role: Return to a former place supplies the escape the wrongdoers ask whether any path can reach.
A traversable extended road materializes the requested means of return.
Supportive alliance is denied as an interpersonal route out of the condition.
The repeated road is now explicitly absent rather than merely sought.
The day itself has no return, closing temporal reversal as well as spatial escape.
Refuge as a place of protective recourse closes the final alternative destination.
Passive placement before an object gives the terminal route pattern a bodily endpoint.
Residence in a place or time changes 'abiding' from bare duration into no-exit emplacement.

structural_cues: 42:44 asks for a return-path; 42:46 denies both allies and any path; 42:47 denies return, refuge, and effective repudiation.
The focus locates the people عَلَيْهَا and the wrongdoers فِى عَذَابٍ مُّقِيمٍ between those route denials.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated return, road, alliance, refuge, display, and residence images; I infer that their denials spatialize muqim as terminal emplacement. The alternative is that muqim marks duration only and the route language independently marks helplessness.

changed_reading.before: Abiding punishment means punishment that lasts a long time.
changed_reading.after: It is a settled no-exit location: they are placed before it after return is sought, and every road, protector, refuge, and temporal reversal is then closed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The ship-to-person transfer is cross-domain and therefore surprising, but it remains anchored in focus q-w-m's branch of arrested standing and in passive display, while 42:32-34 explicitly move from running vessels to stillness, fixation, earned wreck, and inescapable entrapment. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for muqim, not identify the people with ships.

activation_trace.role: Free running and flowing establish the prior mobility from which arrest can be felt.
Loss of movement removes the propulsive condition of the vessels.
Fixity after motion gives the arrested vessels a stable exposed posture.
Entrapment from which one cannot disengage turns stillness into terminal capture.
Water becoming still or a mount stopping from exhaustion lets muqim carry an arrested-motion resonance.
Exposure for inspection gives the arrested condition its public, bodily form.

changed_reading.before: Muqim says only that punishment persists through time.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also feels like arrested motion: once-running agents are stranded in an exposed, fixed condition from which earned consequence leaves no release.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation depends on the packet's non-dominant r-w-y mapping for QAC ر ء ي and on water/thirst branches of ع ذ ب, so it is deliberately form-distant; it remains packet-anchored through those exact focus inventories and through the surah's rain, revival, provision, and mercy sequence. Downstream prose must call it a material resonance and must not claim that تَرَىٰ literally means drinking or quenching.

activation_trace.role: The split inventory's quenching versus thirst image supplies a latent water state beneath the overt seeing form.
Refusal or inability to eat and drink under severe thirst makes punishment bodily deprivation.
Withholding and weaning from a thing make that deprivation sustained rather than momentary.
Rain construed as apportioned provision joins water to the surah's economy of bestowed sustenance.
Life-giving rain supplies the quenching material offered after despair.
Rain reviving dry herbage gives mercy a visible transition from desiccation to life.
Tender mercy identifies what the rain image distributes rather than merely depicting weather.

changed_reading.before: The visual clause and enduring punishment have no material relation to the surah's rain imagery.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root resonance, the exposed people inhabit permanent unquenching: rain elsewhere revives despairing dryness as mercy, while their punishment is figured as continued withholding from that life-giving provision.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The model crosses from revelation mechanics to bodily optics, which makes it surprising; it remains anchored in the focus roots of seeing and concealment and in context branches where hidden communication becomes light through a veil. Downstream prose should frame it as a contrastive architecture of disclosure, not equate the concealed glance with revelation.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge cast in hiddenness opens the surah with concealment that successfully communicates.
The repeated hidden transmission restates concealment as a medium of disclosure near the close.
A screening barrier makes mediated access possible without direct exposure.
Illumination names the disclosed result of the surah's hidden communication.
Open perception places the displayed people in full view.
Their own directed sight is still active but radically narrowed.
Concealment now belongs to an impaired glance rather than to a fruitful medium of knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The hidden glance is solely a bodily symptom of fear.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it inverts the surah's disclosure pattern: hidden communication can open into guiding light, but these fully exposed people retain hiddenness only as a constriction of their own sight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Moving from communal deliberation to judgment display is a cross-domain social reading, but the sh-w-r inventory itself supplies showing and drawing out opinion, while the focus supplies passive display and transfers effective speech to the believers. Downstream prose should qualify this as a structural contrast in agency, not a direct lexical derivation between shura and punishment.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something forth and displaying it makes communal affairs voluntarily presentable.
Drawing out judgment through reciprocal review gives that presentation a participatory voice.
Passive exposure changes voluntary presentation of an affair into involuntary presentation of persons.
Articulated speech belongs to the believers, marking who retains public interpretive agency in the scene.
The displayed people's contribution is reduced from deliberative speech to constrained looking.

changed_reading.before: The focus distributes roles only between punished people and commenting believers.
changed_reading.after: As a contained social contrast, the surah moves from persons who voluntarily display affairs and draw out one another's judgment to persons involuntarily displayed while public speech passes to another community.

strongest_changes: The adjacent ع ر ض forms reverse active turning-away into passive exposure.
The surah's voluntary q-w-m commands become involuntary resurrection and settled punishment.
Cultivation and earnings culminate in kh-s-r whose lost capital is self and household.
Repeated return, path, ally, and refuge denials spatialize muqim as no-exit emplacement.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah reconstruction exposed several mechanisms that a local reading could miss: a staged reversal from seeing to being seen, a root-level conversion of ethical standing into imposed standing, family as sheltering relation, and material outliers from arrested ships and the packet's r-w-y water split.
remaining_uncertainties: The active/passive and q-w-m recurrences are strong, but their causal direction remains a reader inference rather than explicit syntax.
The relational-shelter model integrates distant ayat and the spouse branch of l-j-ʾ, so its network reading should remain below the direct household sense.
The water, hiddenness, and ship activations are valid packet-anchored resonances but should not displace the focus ayah's ordinary visual and punitive constructions.
